newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican corporate debt issuers seen busy in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Mexican corporate debt issuers seen busy in 1997.

text.p: Mexican corporate issuers will dominate the market landscape over the next 12 months, Salomon Brothers said in a market report.
"Several of the largest Mexican companies have significant debt maturities coming due over the next two years," the company said.
"The prospects for continued capital market access is improving with the economic recovery expanding to the consumer sector and domestic volumes are increasing across most industries," it said.
The company said that over the past nine months Mexican corporate debt issuers have placed a total of $3.0 billion.
